value.summary: VMware CX production datastore - critically low free space (CRITICAL)

eventTemplate.title: VMware CX datastore CRITICALLY low on space: {dims:datastore.name}
eventTemplate.description:
Free space on production CX datastore {dims:datastore.name} (vCenter {dims:dt.entity.vmware:vcenter.name}) is {alert_condition} the critical threshold of {threshold} GB.

IMMINENT RISK: when this datastore fills, VMs/hosts on it (e.g. PRODCXFIL01) go unresponsive - this is the failure mode behind the 2026-06-20 PRODCXFIL01 outage. Free space now: delete stale snapshots/backups, storage vMotion VMs off, or expand the datastore.
